correctness.rationale: The ordinary cut complex of K_n square K_2 has Alexander dual B union two pure-layer simplices, where B has at most k-1 occupied columns. The layer skeleton K_+ retracts simplicially onto B up to contiguity, and likewise K_-. In the relative homology long exact sequence the map from the two shifted skeleton homologies onto H_{k-2}(B) is (a,b) -> a+b; its kernel (a,-a) is wedge^{k-1} U_n with layer-swap sign -1. Equivariant combinatorial Alexander duality adds the 2n-vertex determinant, trivial on S_n and (-1)^n on layer exchange, yielding epsilon^{n+1} in reduced degree 2n-k-2. The hook character is the (k-1) exterior coefficient of the standard module. Independent direct signed Lefschetz traces for n=4..6 corroborated the claimed action; these finite traces do not prove the all-n concentration.
